content: Hessa gishshas ta naazoo neni Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa kiyateththan minna.
Daro markkatta sinththan ne taappe siyidayssa harata tamaarsanaas dandayzaytassinne ammanettida asatas hadara imma.
Yesus Kirstoosas ammanettida lo7o wottadara mala tanara meto ekka.
Wottadarateththan ooththizaadey ba halaqaa ufayssanaas dafettees attiin hara bana qaxeththiza ooson geli erenna.
Hessaththoka gaadde woxxizaadey woththa woga naagontta woxxiko xoono akilile ekkenna.
Gooba goshshanchchay ba goyi kessida kaththa xeera mizaade gidanaas bessees.
Ta nees gizayssa ne wozinan woththa siyikko Goday nees yo7o ubbaan akeeka immana.
Hayqoppe dendida Dawite zereth gidida Yesus Kirstoosa qoppa; ta yootiza mishiraachcho qaalaykka hessa.
Hessa gaason iita ooththida asa mala qashettana gakkanaas waaye beyays; gido attiin Xoossa qaalay qashettenna.
Hessa gishshas Kirstoosa baggara diza atoteththinne mernaa bonchcho demmana doorettidayta gishshas gaada wursaka dandayadis.
geetettida qaalay ammanettidayssa.
Mino Oosanchcha
Hayta ha yo7ota gishshas asaa qofso aggofa; asay ba giddon issoy issaara qaalaa gaason palamettontta mala Xoossa sunththan zora; hessa mala yo7oy siyizayta moorees.
Tumu Xoossaa qaala yootizaade, yeellachchontta oosanchchanne asi ne gishshas lo7o markkattizaade gidada nenateththaa wursa Xoossa sinth shiishshanaas minna.
Coo mela doona lallabeteththafe haakka; hessa mala yo7on waaxettida asati Xoossafe haakki haakki beettes.
Istta timirtey sakkidi paxontta gede gujji gujji daaketti biza madunththa mala; Hemenewoosinne Qasse Filxoosa geetettizayti hessa mala timirte tamaarzayta giddon deettes.
Heyti tumateththafe haakkidi coo mela waayeettes; isttika, «Hayqoppe denththi hayssafe kase hani aadhdhides» giidi issi issi asaa ammano shiri yeggeettes.
Gido attiin, «Goday baas gidizayta erees.» Qasseka, «Godaa sunth xeygizay wuri iitappe haakko» giza maatamey iza bolla diza laamettontta Xoossaa yochchay laamettibeenna.
Issi gita keeththan worqqafenne birappe xalla gidontta miththafenne urqqafe oosettidayti dizayssaththo heytanttafekka baggayti bonchcho oosos, baggayti qasse hiraysso oosos eketteettes.
Hessa gishshas oonikka hayta ta gida iita yo7otappe bana geeshshiko; hessaadey bonchcho oosos gidizaadenne anjjettidaade; Godaa go7izaadenne lo7o oosos giigettidaade gidana.
Panththateththa iita amoteththafe baqata; geeshsha wozinara Godaa xeygiza asatara xilloteth, ammano, siiqonne saroteth kaalla.
Go7aynne hidotay baynda eeyata palamappe haakka; gaasoykka hessantta malay oosh kaaleththizayssa ne eraasa.
Godaa oosanchchay asara ooyettanaas bessenna; hessafe bollara asa ubbaa achchan kiya, as tamaarsanaas dandayzaadenne mino as gidanaas bessees.
Izi banara eqettiza asata ashketeththara oykkizaade gidanaas bessees; oonee erizay istti tumaa erana mala Xoossi isttas maarettanaas wode immana dandayees.
Hessika istti yuushshi qoppi simmidi iza shene kunththana mala istta di7i efida Xala7e narxafe istti kessi ekkana.
